Q6097.reason: If the estate to the cousin is treated as a fee tail or its equivalent, the grantor keeps a reversion, and his later fee simple deed passes that reversion to the niece.

Q5137.reason: The best evidence rule covers x-rays as well as writings, so the x-rays themselves are the proper proof of the distension.

Q5526.reason: Under modern burglary statutes, entering a building through a window with intent to steal is burglary even by day, while the other options lack a breaking or entry with felonious intent at the time of entry.
